1\. Shutdown can fail a job when no void happened 🐞 Bug ≡ Correctness 
Exchange._fail calls gw.mark_unreachable before _decide checks self.abandoned, so an
exchange that shutdown records as usage_unknown rather than a void can still set exit status 3. If
a first connect fails but its retry is still streaming when shutdown abandons the request, closing
the upstream socket can send the relay through _fail; _decide then returns None, yet the
nonzero gateway status fails the job.
Agent Prompt ``` ## Issue description `Exchange._fail` marks the gateway unreachable before the locked void decision, so shutdown can record an abandoned request as non-void while the gateway still exits with status 3. ## Fix Focus Areas - hb/gateway.py[923-939] - hb/gateway.py[875-893] ## Recommended Fix Move `mark_unreachable` into `_decide`’s locked `if void:` branch, after the `self.abandoned` check and before `_record`, or pass a flag to `_decide` to achieve the same ordering. Keep the status set before a void record becomes visible, but never set it for an abandoned request.
